cases.note: ROOT-CAUSED 2026-07-10: same proven class as GFM_IEEE123/Run_IEEE123Bus_GFMSnap (TOLERANCE_NOTES.md par. floating-delta), one tier weaker. REGBUS2 sits between TWO delta windings (Transformer.Reg1/Reg2 winding 2) -> no zero-seq ground path; measured zero-seq pinning admittance -j2.14e-8 S vs ~303 S diagonal -> amplification 1.4e10. Decomposition: the whole 5.2191e-3 V gap is common mode on all three REGBUS2 nodes (differential remainder <=1.4e-10 V, L-L <=2.7e-10 V); every other node matches to ~1e-14 rel; Y bit-identical (worst rel 0.0); injections match <1e-9 A; iterations equal. Un-pinnable across solvers at ANY LU accuracy this weakly pinned (KLU-quality residual ~1e-11 A -> ~5e-4 V slack), so even WP-R1 refinement only shrinks, not closes, it. Disposition options: per-bus common-mode exclusion in the compare, or stays documented-skipped.

ROOT-CAUSED 2026-07-10: same proven class as GFM_IEEE123/Run_IEEE123Bus_GFMSnap (TOLERANCE_NOTES.md par. floating-delta), extreme variant. BG (0.6 kV) is a DEAD-END bus behind Transformer.Tg winding 2 with no ground reference in its zero-seq (the deck's Generator.WindGen1 at Bg is commented out): measured zero-seq pinning ~1e-12 S vs ~0.42 S diagonal -> amplification 4.2e11. Decomposition: the whole 1.0563e-2 V gap is common mode on all three BG nodes (differential remainder <=6.5e-14 V, L-L <=1.3e-13 V -- bit-level); every other node matches to ~2e-14 rel; Y bit-identical (worst rel 5.8e-16); injections <1e-9 A apart; iterations equal (2). At 4e11 amplification the common mode is un-pinnable across solvers at any accuracy (even a 1e-13 A residual -> ~0.04 V); refinement cannot close it. Disposition options: per-bus common-mode exclusion in the compare, or stays documented-skipped.
